Name: PRIMARY
Description: The primary header containing the keywords following the standard format

Name: INSTRUMENT_HEADER
Description: The original instrument header

Name: RECEIPT
Description: The list of operations performed on this file

Name: DRP_CONFIG
Description: Pipeline details to go from the raw file to this file

Name: EXT_DESCRIPT
Description: Contains the description of all the extensions in the file

Name: ORDER_TABLE
Description: Table capturing the wavelength extent of each order as well as some extra info on SNR etc.

Name: TRACE1_FLUX
Description: The flux measured in trace 1 (for now FOX extracted and therefore already unblazed)

Name: TRACE1_WAVE
Description: The wavelength associated to the flux in trace 1

Name: TRACE1_VAR
Description: The variance for trace 1

Name: TRACE1_BLAZE
Description: The blaze for trace 1

Name: BARYCORR_KMS
Description: The barycentric correction in km/s stored as a one-element image array

Name: BARYCORR_Z
Description: The barycentric correction in redshift stored as a one-element image array

Name: BJD_TDB
Description: Photon weighted midpoint in BJD TDB stored as a one-element image array

Name: FIB_B_FLUX
Description: The flux measured in fiber B

Name: FIB_B_WAVE
Description: The wavelength associated to the fiber B flux

Name: FIB_B_VAR
Description: The variance for fiber B

Name: FIB_B_BLAZE
Description: The blaze for fiber B

Name: RAW_IMAGE
Description: The raw VIS detector image

Name: RAW_IMAGE_SCA2
Description: The raw NIR SCA2 detector image

Name: RAW_IMAGE_SCA1
Description: The raw NIR SCA1 detector image
